Pet Food Packaging Buyer Guide

A B2B specification guide for heavy-duty pet food bags, flat bottom bags, zipper strength and puncture resistance.

Buyer Answer Snapshot

  • This page gives practical industrial parameters, not generic marketing text.
  • Use these points to prepare RFQ details before contacting the factory.
  • MOQ is 500 PCS for custom packaging projects.

Laminate thickness

Pet food bags commonly use PET/VMPET/PE with 120–180 µm total thickness depending on kibble size, fat content and filling weight.

Zipper choice

For 2 kg+ bags, heavy-duty 8–12 mm zipper or slider zipper is recommended for repeat opening and closing.

Drop test

A filled bag drop test at 1.0 m on six faces helps validate seal strength and bottom gusset durability before mass production.
